tools.name: rotate_log_config
tools.description: Applies a logrotate configuration by shelling out to `logrotate {config}`. The config value is concatenated directly into the command line; there is no validation or escaping step before it reaches the shell, so any operator running this tool controls exactly what gets executed.

config.description: Contents of the logrotate config block to apply, e.g. '/var/log/app.log { daily; rotate 7 }'
